title: Why South Korea Has More Robots Than People On Its Factory Floors
hook: One country now has way more robot coworkers than you have fingers.
closing: More robots than people, at least on that factory floor.
question: Would a robot coworker worry you?

segments.say: South Korea now runs 1,220 robots for every ten thousand factory workers, the highest density anywhere.
Korea has nearly four times as many robots on the factory floor as the United States has.
China installs more robots than any other country, yet ranks far lower once you measure density instead of raw count.
